observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 console with the front cover open, revealing a small screen with a purple icon. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it. A coiled black cable is wrapped in plastic next to the console.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, with the black side panel visible. The same controller and cable are present. The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The console has a glossy black side panel with ventilation slits and a small red button on the side.
The controller has the standard PlayStation button layout: four face buttons, two analog sticks, and a central touchpad.
The cable appears to be a USB-C to USB-A cable, coiled and wrapped in plastic.
No FIFA disc game or accessories are visible in either photo.
The console's screen is off in both photos, and no power or connection is shown.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show a PlayStation 5 console and a DualSense controller.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc game or accessories are visible in either photo. The only visible items are the console, controller, and cable.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The controller may not function properly or may be missing a battery or charging cable.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: The FIFA disc game may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the FIFA disc game and any accessories included.

risks.risk: The console may have been tampered with or have a damaged disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console loading a game disc and playing it.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
Photo or video showing the FIFA disc game and any accessories included.
Video of the console loading and playing a game disc.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
